items.title: 3 Insurance Dividend Stocks Built to Keep Paying Through Tough Times
items.summary: Insurers get paid first and settle claims later, and that gap quietly funds some of the market's most durable dividends. Three NYSE giants spend only a sliver of profits on payouts, yet one faces a storm-season swing the others dodge.

items.title: NMIH Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates on Higher Claims and Costs
items.summary: NMI Holdings' Q3 earnings face pressure from rising claims and expenses, despite portfolio growth and stronger investment income.

items.title: PLMR Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Premium Growth
items.summary: Palomar's Q3 earnings jump 49.8% as strong premium growth and investment income fuel results, prompting higher 2026 earnings guidance.

items.title: 3 Dividend Aristocrats Wall Street Analysts Like Most
items.summary: Decades of rising payouts earned these three stocks a place among the Dividend Aristocrats, but Wall Street's opinions on them could not be more different. One has near-unanimous praise, one has fallen hard, and one has analysts split down the middle.

items.title: UNM Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Premium Growth and Investment Income

items.title: Rate Hikes Could Be Coming: History Likes These 4 Insurance Stocks
